{{Quote|I heard about something like that happening over at the Draukyze system a couple of months back. Same kind of hit-and-fade, except there was only one Star Destroyer on that one.|[[Lachton]] to [[Talon Karrde]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]|<ref name="Heir" />}}
In the last weeks of [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] '''raided''' the [[Draukyze system/Legends|Draukyze system]] in a hit-and-fade attack with a single [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] in order to test his forces.<ref name="Heir" /> The raid was one of a number of attacks on the border of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] that were celebrated by the remnants of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Atlas" /> The attack was a thing of rumor among smugglers, and was reported to [[Talon Karrde]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] by their copilot, [[Lachton]], who was present at a [[Attack on Bpfassh|similar attack]] at [[Bpfassh]].<ref name="Heir" />
